title: Sweet&Chilli
description: Sweet & Chilli is a vanilla-friendly Minecraft modpack that enhances your game without changing its core feel.Packed with the best optimization, animation, and quality-of-life mods, it delivers smoother performance, for a better gaming experience.
body: Sweet&Chilli is a vanilla+ Minecraft experience that stays true to the spirit of the original game while carefully enhancing it in every way. It improves performance, adds smooth quality-of-life features, so nothing ever feels out of place
